summary: The April rainfall deficit that ECIU identifies as the first of the year's three hits on UK cereals: England recorded just 38% of its average April rainfall, ahead of the May, June and July heatwaves and the near-total absence of rain since mid-June in the East of England. Figure originates with the Met Office and is cited in ECIU's notes to editors.
title: UK harvest on track for historic lows after drought and heatwaves desiccate crops
verbatim_quote: England was particularly dry, recording just 38% of its average April rainfall
